children: SAID ON WEDNSEDAY ANNOUNCED PRELIMINARY RESULT OF MANDATORY OFFER
AT THE EXPIRY OF THE OFFER PERIOD, HEMEN HAD RECEIVED ACCEPTANCES OF THE OFFER IN RESPECT OF 60,261,375 SHARES, ABOUT 19.9% OF ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL
FOLLOWING COMPLETION OF THE OFFER, HEMEN WILL HOLD 251,623,429 SHARES, REPRESENTING ABOUT 83% OF THE ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL AND VOTING RIGHTS IN NOL
FINAL RESULT OF THE OFFER WILL BE ANNOUNCED ONCE CONFIRMED BY THE RECEIVING AGENT, EXPECTED DURING 11 SEPTEMBER 2026
